description: Madagascar - Planned transmission network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. This dataset is put together by KTH Division of Energy Systems Analysis. It contains the planned transmission lines (62-220 kV) according to information available from Madagascar Office de Regulations de l'Electricite, last updated in 2014 ( and information provided by the Artelia Group and JIRAMA. Coverage: Madagascar. It has 1 file in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
